117:t_1:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「...That concludes my situation report and my personal request.」

117:t_1:4.en:
$$カティ$$
「I understand. We'll also investigate the units that have left the chain of command.」

117:t_1:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Is $$クロノ$$ behind it after all...?」

117:t_1:8.en:
$$カティ$$
「I'm a Brigadier General. ...Honestly... You never get used to that, do you?」

117:t_1:9.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I've already gotten used to the name $$パトリック・マネキン$$, though.」

117:t_1:10.en:
$$カティ$$
「Never mind. This call is half personal anyway. I'll overlook a little joking.」

117:t_1:11.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Then how about whispering sweet nothings...?」

117:t_1:12.en:
$$カティ$$
「Don't get carried away. I wouldn't say those things even on an entirely personal call.」

117:t_1:13.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I know, I know. You mean we should do that in person, rather than over a call.」

117:t_1:14.en:
$$カティ$$
「...That side of you keeps me going...」

117:t_1:15.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But I'm sorry. I... don't think I'll be able to see you for a while, Colonel.」

117:t_1:16.en:
$$カティ$$
「Is this about your earlier request...?」

117:t_1:17.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Our only way out of this situation is to concentrate our forces and break through at a single point.」

117:t_1:18.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'd like to join $c and help however I can.」

117:t_1:19.en:
$$カティ$$
「So you've started thinking about strategy too... My lectures were worthwhile after all.」

117:t_1:21.en:
$$カティ$$
「I approve Lieutenant $$パトリック・マネキン$$'s request. You are to join the independent unit $c and place yourself under its command.」

117:t_1:23.en:
$$カティ$$
「I'll also give you another assignment. I want you to act as a guide.」

117:t_1:24.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What's that supposed to mean?」

117:t_1:25.en:
$$カティ$$
「Someone else has had the same idea as you. Join $c together with him.」

117:t_1:26.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Is he someone I know?」

117:t_1:27.en:
$$カティ$$
「He's a dependable man. He should be arriving there about now.」

117:t_1:30.en:
???
「I'm glad to have the chance to fight beside you again.」

117:t_1:31.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So am I, $$プリベンター・ライトニング$$.」

117:t_1:35.en: ～$$ネェル・アーガマ$$　Briefing Room～

117:t_1:36.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...As I already explained, the $$新地球皇国$$ has laid $$レイライン$$ across this North American continent too, building $$ターミナル・ベース$$ installations throughout it.」

117:t_1:39.en:
$$レイアム$$
「And the $$セントラル・ベース$$ coordinates them all, serving as the center of the enemy's strategy on this continent.」

117:t_1:40.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That means capturing the $$セントラル・ベース$$ will let us turn the tide of the war in our favor all at once.」

117:t_1:41.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Until now, the $$地球連邦$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$ have been evenly matched here in North America, but...」

117:t_1:42.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Now that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$クロノ$$ have begun openly helping the Empire, the $$地球連邦$$ will likely be at a disadvantage.」

117:t_1:43.en:
$$オットー$$
「In other words, we have no time left to spare.」

117:t_1:44.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Naturally, the $$セントラル・ベース$$ is surrounded by a heavily armed defensive line.」

117:t_1:45.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So if we charge in blindly, we'll just get crushed.」

117:t_1:46.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「After discussions with the $$連邦軍$$, we agreed on a plan: they'll stage a large-scale diversion nearby while we storm the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:47.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll be the force that decides the battle...」

117:t_1:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But there's also what happened with $$ダバラーン$$ the other day. $$サイデリアル$$ is probably watching our movements too.」

117:t_1:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I think that gives us an opening to exploit.」

117:t_1:51.en:
$$オットー$$
「Yes. We'll draw the enemy's attention as a diversion so the diversionary force can deploy.」

117:t_1:52.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we make a big show of moving, the Empire will have to send forces our way... That will give the main $$連邦軍$$ force more room to maneuver.」

117:t_1:53.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If that opens a hole in the enemy's defensive line, the main $$連邦軍$$ force will use it to launch a breakthrough toward the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:54.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So each side serves as the other's diversion, and either can become the main attack...」

117:t_1:55.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Then let's make a real spectacle of it!」

117:t_1:56.en:
$n
「I agree. Giving them a nasty surprise will boost our morale too.」

117:t_1:57.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I expected that kind of hotheaded suggestion, so I've already chosen our target.」

117:t_1:58.en:
$$オットー$$
「$c will begin by attacking the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ in $$オーティス$$, $$テキサス$$.」

117:t_1:59.en:
$$マリー$$
「$$オーティス$$...? I feel like I've heard that place name somewhere, but...」

117:t_1:62.en:
$$カツ$$
「She's a girl who was a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$. I've never met her either, though.」

117:t_1:63.en:
$$アムロ$$
「She's a junior colleague of $$クロウ$$, the $$揺れる天秤$$ $$スフィア・リアクター$$. Like him, she's a $$次元獣$$ Buster.」

117:t_1:64.en:
$$フォウ$$
「《$$次元獣$$》 are large hostile creatures that appear from another dimension, right?」

117:t_1:65.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They've hardly been seen since the $$再世戦争$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$ ended, though.」

117:t_1:66.en:
$$カツ$$
「If she's a $$次元獣$$ Buster, she's with Dr. $$トライア$$, right...?」

117:t_1:68.en:
$$ファ$$
「Now that you mention it, you're right... We can practically say there aren't any $$次元獣$$ left.」

117:t_1:69.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Especially since her hometown has become a $$サイデリアル$$ base, I'd like her to fight alongside us.」

117:t_1:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm sure she has her reasons.」

117:t_1:72.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I've heard $$オーティス$$ was where the first $$次元獣$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$'s history appeared, but...」

117:t_1:73.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's right. The entire town was wiped out, leaving only $$エスター$$ alive...」

117:t_1:75.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「According to Dr. $$トライア$$'s research, that town lies within a dimensional distortion.」

117:t_1:76.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「A $$次元獣$$ appeared through a tear in the dimensional boundary there. During the $$時獄戦役$$, it was also one of the places most severely affected by the slowing of time.」

117:t_1:77.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「And now a $$新地球皇国$$ base has been built there.」

117:t_1:78.en:
$$マリー$$
「That town has been at the mercy of the multiverse...」

117:t_1:81.en:
$$オットー$$
「A considerable force has gathered in $$オーティス$$. If we capture it, we'll both draw the Empire's attention and gain a foothold for the assault on the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「We leave in three hours. Everyone, get ready.」
